<!--
Keep this issue small enough to review in one sitting and to close with a single focused PR.
Architecture/decision tickets must land before the implementation tickets they unblock.
Delete guidance comments before submitting, but keep every heading you use.

NOTE FOR AUGGIE (and anyone building tickets):
Not every section below belongs in every ticket. Keep tickets focused and easy to
read — include only the sections the work actually needs, rather than filling all
of them. Choose sections based on the context of the work.

- MANDATORY (include in every ticket): Planning ID, Purpose, Background, Scope,
  Acceptance criteria, Testing requirements.
- OPTIONAL (include only when they add value for this ticket): everything else.
  Delete the heading entirely when a section does not apply — do not leave empty
  or boilerplate sections.

Each heading below is annotated (Mandatory) or (Optional) in its guidance comment.
Prefer a short, relevant ticket over a long one with many empty sections.
-->

## Planning ID
<!-- (Mandatory) e.g. MEL-041. Must match the ID in docs/planning/github-issue-plan.md. -->

## Purpose
<!-- (Mandatory) One or two sentences: what this issue delivers and why it exists now. -->

## User/engineering value
<!-- (Optional) Who benefits (learner, reviewer, future contributor) and the concrete value delivered. -->

## Background
<!-- (Mandatory) Context a contributor refreshing MERN needs: prior issues, decisions, relevant docs/ADRs. -->

## Scope
<!-- (Mandatory) Bullet the exact work included. Be specific about files/areas touched. -->

## Non-goals
<!-- (Optional) What this issue deliberately does NOT do, to keep the PR focused. -->

## Architecture questions to resolve
<!-- (Optional) Open questions to answer before/while implementing. Omit for pure impl tickets. -->

## Implementation notes
<!-- (Optional) Suggested approach, patterns to follow, gotchas, references to existing code. -->

## Acceptance criteria
<!-- (Mandatory) Objective, checkable outcomes. Prefer 3-6 items. -->
- [ ]
- [ ]
- [ ]

## Testing requirements
<!-- (Mandatory) What must be tested and how (unit/integration/component/e2e). Name the runner. -->

## Accessibility requirements
<!-- (Optional) Keyboard, focus, screen-reader, contrast, motion, touch targets. Omit if truly none. -->

## Documentation requirements
<!-- (Optional) Docs/ADRs/README/JSDoc to add or update. -->

## Dependencies
<!-- (Optional) Issue IDs that must be done first (blocked by). -->

## Blocks (issues blocked by this)
<!-- (Optional) Issue IDs that cannot start until this is done. -->

## Suggested labels
<!-- (Optional) e.g. area:frontend, area:backend, type:feature, type:docs, type:test, a11y. -->

## Suggested milestone
<!-- (Optional) M1..M14 from docs/planning/implementation-roadmap.md. -->

## Size
<!-- (Optional) XS / S / M / L / XL -->

## Fits one focused PR? (yes/no)
<!-- (Optional) If "no", split the issue before starting. -->

## Recommended branch name
<!-- (Optional) e.g. feat/speech-bubble, docs/domain-model, ci/github-actions. -->

## Draft PR objective
<!-- (Optional) The single outcome the draft PR should demonstrate for review. -->

## Known risks
<!-- (Optional) Technical/product risks and mitigations. -->

## Deferred follow-up work
<!-- (Optional) Explicitly out-of-scope items to capture as future issues. -->
